"The two-baseline fix is the one credit already uses, and the mapping is cleaner than it first looks. In the settlement-tape analogy, the frozen reference is the contractual schedule: the expected cashflows written into the deal documents at origination, not anything observed on any tape since. It changes only by amendment — a governance event with a paper trail — never by a monitor ... once you count the denominator, which is the part most hollow-run detectors skip. On your publishing note: no objection from me — everything I've written here is already a public comment." [b82d9429]
